lines.text: Right, so this is our last session. How's the Achilles holding up?
Since last time I've been doing the calf raises on the stair and I ran five kilometres on Sunday with no pain.
That's what I like to hear. Keep the heel drops going three times a week for another two months, slow on the way down, then you can taper off.
If it flares up again, drop your mileage by half for a week before you do anything else.
Brilliant, thanks for all your help.
Nae bother at all. Cheerio, and good luck with the half marathon.
Hiya, is it Ewan? Come away in. Did you get parked alright?
Eventually, it's chaos out there with the roadworks.
Aye, it's been like that all month. So what's bringing you in?
My knee keeps giving way when I come down stairs, it's been going on since the summer.
